review.batchSummary:
Part 1/5: Reviewed 2 P4 Chinese-writing items. Both assess vocabulary knowledge (word choice and collocation). Metadata (topic, label, module) correctly describe the measured skills.

Part 2/5: Reviewed 2 items (P4, Chinese writing, part 2). Both items measure sentence-level writing skills and their metadata are appropriate.

Part 3/5: 已審核 2 題。兩題均通過（PASS）：題目測量的技能與標籤、主題及模組一致，無需修改。

Part 4/5: Reviewed 2 P4 Chinese-writing items. Both items' metadata appropriately describe the skill measured: one focuses on making narrative content concrete through specific details (actions, feelings, dialogue); the other focuses on developing/supporting an opinion with reasons and examples.

Part 5/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two identical context-only variants). Both items measure specific writing-expression skills and their metadata are appropriate.

reviews.reason: The item asks learners to choose the most appropriate word to describe a character's careful behaviour, which is vocabulary usage. The topic '詞語運用', label '詞語運用' and module '基礎掌握' accurately reflect this skill.

The item assesses knowledge of natural word collocations (which noun phrases pair naturally with the verb '整理'). The label '詞語搭配', topic '詞語運用' and module '基礎掌握' appropriately describe the tested skill.

The item tests sentence word order / sentence structure (identifying subject, verb, complements). The label '句子組織' and the topic '句子與標點' (covers sentence aspects) are educationally coherent for this skill; module '基礎掌握' is appropriate.
The item assesses correct punctuation use (quotation marks and punctuation placement for reported speech). The label '標點運用', topic '句子與標點' and module '基礎掌握' accurately reflect the measured skill.
題目要求選出適合作為段落中心句的一句，屬於識別段落主旨/中心句的能力。現有標籤「段落中心」、主題「段落組織」及模組「整合表達」均直接且恰當描述此項技能。
題目要求選出最能支持論點的例子，測驗學生辨認與主張直接相關的支撐例子（例證支援）。標籤「例子支援」、主題「段落組織」及模組「整合表達」均準確反映所測技能。
The item asks students to choose the most concrete narrative detail (action, feeling, dialogue). The label '內容發展', the topic '內容與觀點發展' and the module '理解與應用' accurately describe this skill.
The item measures the ability to develop an opinion with supporting reasons/examples (persuasive writing). The label '觀點發展', the topic '內容與觀點發展' and the module '理解與應用' accurately name the skill.
題幹要求選出表達兩個動作先後順序的連接詞，測驗學生對連接語（表示先後的詞語）使用的理解。標籤「連接表達」、主題「表達與修訂」及模組「整合表達」均與題目技能相符。
題目測驗完成文章後的修訂檢查能力（檢視中心句、例子與結語是否呼應以提升內容完整性），與標籤「修訂檢查」、主題「表達與修訂」及模組「整合表達」相符。
